overall_diagnosis: The T30 math regression is primarily a STYLE-POLICY displacement: bounded short-target supervision (H3/H5/H6, 1600-char build rejection) trained the adapter into a terse answer mode; under frozen short-form prompts it under-derives and its chains break (ArithmeticError/derivation-wrong labels, Phase 1). It is addressable by adding long-form VERIFIED derivation supervision alongside the MC/protocol modes (candidates A/B), and NOT primarily by budget (H4), protocol data (H1), or backbone damage alone (H2).
